rules.title: CHANGELOG Unreleased (Time): the dashboard loads time data from the reader
CHANGELOG Unreleased (Time): the reader logs each time data read with the course and the viewer's role (logs) (PR #320)
While a student is signed in, the reader shall save the student's edits to a whiteboard learning object in a room that only that student's session can read or overwrite.
The reader shall store a signed-in student's learning records, calendar, sentiment, online status and shared presence under the GitHub login of the session, whatever student id the request names.
When a student opens a learning object, the reader shall send the learning event to the reader's server without publishing it over Realtime from the browser.
When the reader's server receives a learning event, the reader shall publish it only to the activity feeds a live dashboard has watched in the last 90 seconds.
While it shows a course or the platform feed, the live dashboard shall report itself as a watcher of that feed every 60 seconds.
Tutors shall build its images on a Node base image pinned by digest, moved only by a Dependabot pull request.
